title: 200::/7 prefix in RPL DODAG
close_reason: Superseded by the resolved single-primary address model: nodes self-derive exact 0200::/8 native /128 addresses, so RPL DODAG formation MUST NOT advertise 200::/7 (or 0200::/8) Prefix Information. Border-router global reachability is advertised with the RPL Grounded bit instead. Verified by Python gateway-reachability vectors (4 passed) and Rust gateway/root DIO tests (2 passed), which assert no Prefix Information option.
